text:
incident-bot: Pager: P2 - hosted-api (us-west-2) 5xx spike detected — error_rate 5.8% over 2m, latency stable. AlertID: pager-usr-4482

Priya (SRE): acknowledging, jumping in. seeing a sharp uptick in 502/504 from dedicated pool nodes behind alb-dedicated-*-usw2.
- Short triage: 5xx distributed across model-serving pods, not single pod hot loop.
- Quick checks running: `kubectl get pods -n redwood-serving | grep crash` then `curl -sS https://hosted-api-usw2.internal/health | jq .`

Alex (oncall): oncall here, thanks @Priya. Any signs of infra (disk/IO) or kernel OOM? can we SLO traffic to fallback region?

Priya (SRE): no OOMs in dmesg, node CPU/mem normal. connection errors in proxy logs: `connect: connection refused` and intermittent `502 from upstream` from alb. Suspect L4->L7 degradation between ALB and backends.

Jordan (Cloud Eng): I'm on AWS console now. I'm seeing increased backend connection errors on the ALB in us-west-2 and a subset of ENIs showing high retransmits. Opening an AWS escalation (SEV-2) now.

vendor-aws-bot: AWS Support Case created: case-id 1234567890; severity: high; assigned to TAM; initial slack update queued. ETA first response: 12 mins.

Maya (Customer Success): Starting customer impact triage. Which customers are hitting us-west-2 only? I can ping top-10 accounts and draft a status page blurb. Need impact window + mitigation plan.

Sam (Support): I have a queue of inbound tickets showing increased 502 errors. I'll tag top-affected accounts and start pre-batching outbound messages to the affected tenant owners. Any wording guidance?

Alex (oncall): short mitigations:
- Reroute new traffic for non-geo-sensitive customers to hosted-api-us-east-1 via routing policy A/B fallback (console -> routing -> move 30% then 100%).
- Enable autoscaling buffer for Dedicated (increase reserved connections) as temporary throttle.
- Put failing receivers into circuit-breaker for 5m to avoid cascading.

Priya (SRE): executing quick mitigation: applying temporary ALB target deregistration for the worst 6 nodes and flipping routing fallback. Running commands:
```
# remove targets (dry-run first)
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:... --targets Id=i-0abcd1234
# update routing (pseudo)
redwood routing update --service hosted-api --strategy fallback --region us-east-1 --weight 0.3
```

Priya (SRE): also collecting logs and saving a trace for the post-incident eval: `pgrep -af 'model_server' | xargs -n1 -I{} gdb -batch -ex 'thread apply all bt' -p {}` (only if safe).

Jordan (Cloud Eng): AWS update: initial network team response says they see transient ENI failures and are validating an internal fix. They created a network-level mitigation to rebalance ENIs. AWS expects a partial improvement within ~15-30m, full fix 40-60m. Case ID 1234567890. I'm pushing for a faster mitigation.

vendor-aws-bot: Update on case 1234567890: mitigation (ENI rebalance) applied to impacted subnets; monitoring for recovery. Next update in 20 minutes or earlier.

Maya (Customer Success): Draft status page message (please review):
```
Summary: We are experiencing elevated 5xx errors for our hosted API in the us-west-2 region affecting some customers. Our engineers are actively mitigating by rebalancing traffic and applying infrastructure mitigations.
Impact: Intermittent request failures (5xx) for requests routed to us-west-2. Some requests may succeed on retry or when routed to alternative regions.
Action: We have engaged our cloud provider and applied traffic fallback to us-east-1 for impacted traffic; we are monitoring recovery.
ETA: Full recovery expected within 1 hour. We will update this page with progress.
```
Can someone sign off for publication? :eyes:

Alex (oncall): LGTM, small tweak: add "no customer data exposure" and include workaround: retry 1x or use region param.

Maya (Customer Success): updated and publishing now to status.redwood.ai/incidents/1849012345. Will send targeted email to affected accounts after we confirm partial recovery.

Sam (Support): sending short email template to affected customers for review:
```
Subject: Brief outage impacting requests to us-west-2
Hi <Customer>,
We're investigating intermittent 5xx errors affecting requests routed to our us-west-2 region. We've applied traffic fallbacks and engaged AWS. We'll follow up with updates and a post-incident report.
Regards, Redwood Support
```

Priya (SRE): we are seeing initial drop in error rate to ~2.1% after ENI rebalancing and target rotation. Not fully stable though. Continuing to monitor.

Jordan (Cloud Eng): AWS just messaged: "we've applied an additional control plane throttle fix; backend retransmits reduced by ~70% in instrumented subnets." They request logs for deeper RCA; I'm providing them.

incident-bot: Note: On-call rotation reminder — Priya has 30m left in shift. Please prepare handoff.

Priya (SRE): Handoff summary for night oncall (Alex):
- Incident: us-west-2 elevated 5xx due to ALB->ENI networking issue (AWS case 1234567890).
- Current state: error_rate lowered to ~1.8%, stable for 5m but monitoring. Fallback traffic to us-east-1 in place (30% -> 100% if regressions). Targets rotated and 6 bad nodes drained.
- Open action items: (1) Confirm AWS RCA when provided, (2) run post-incident eval against prompt set for affected models, (3) draft customers postmortem and notify Account teams.

Alex (oncall): taking handoff, thanks @Priya. I'll keep the rotation notes and watch for any regression. If error rate >3% re-escalate and flip full region routing.

Jordan (Cloud Eng): AWS update (via vendor-aws-bot): "Case 1234567890: network team confirms root cause related to ENI firmware bug in subset of instances; global mitigation in progress; fix planned in next 48hrs for full fleet. For now rebalancing should avoid recurrence."

vendor-aws-bot: Case 1234567890 — note added: vendor recommends instance replacement for long-term fix.

Maya (Customer Success): publishing customer notifications now (targeted). I'll add note: "we will follow up with a post-incident report once AWS RCA is available"

Sam (Support): marking affected tickets as "mitigated" and adding status page link. will escalate any customers who report continued impact.

Priya (SRE): leaving monitoring on. creating follow-up tasks: postmortem, inventory of drained nodes, and model-eval runbook.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to oncall (Alex). Status: monitoring. Incident channel archived in 2h if no further alerts.

Alex (oncall): thanks team. I'll keep updates here if anything changes; otherwise will start postmortem template in #postmortems after stabilization. :thumbsup:

vendor-aws-bot: Final automated update queued: "We will deliver RCA and remediation plan to Redwood within 48 hours."
